description: This file implements the HeyGen transport integration for the Pipecat framework, including classes for input/output transports, session management, and event handling for real-time conversational AI with avatars via the HeyGen platform.

classes.name: HeyGenInputTransport
classes.description: Handles incoming audio streams and events from HeyGen conversations, manages audio capture from participants.

classes.name: HeyGenOutputTransport
classes.description: Manages outgoing audio streams and events to HeyGen conversations, handles speech start/stop and interruptions.

classes.name: HeyGenParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the HeyGen transport, including enabling/disabling audio input/output.

classes.name: HeyGenTransport
classes.description: Main transport class that manages session initialization, participant connection/disconnection, and provides input/output transport instances.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Returns the input transport instance for receiving media and events.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the output transport instance for sending media and events.

methods.name: _on_participant_connected
methods.description: Handles participant connection events and starts audio capture.

methods.name: _on_client_connected
methods.description: Handles client connection events, triggers event handlers.

methods.name: _on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, triggers event handlers.
